strategy.title: No plan: the whole counted market is worth $25,500, below the $40,000 target
strategy.why: The state association directory counts 85 member clubs in total, each needing one workbook, at an evidenced $300: every club buying yields $25,500 gross ($25,160 net of $4 costs) against $40,000; 134 sales would be needed.

alternatives.title: Sell the workbook to the 85 clubs for a lower target
alternatives.why: Conversion is 25% (10/40), so ~21 sales (~$6,300) is the measured expectation; only a reduced target is supportable.

steps.label: Search for further openings or buyer populations beyond the 85 counted clubs, or have the owner lower the target

brain.summary: INFEASIBLE AS STATED: the openings held sell into markets research counted whole: every buyer in them agreeing at the top price brings at most $25,500, so they cannot reach the $40,000 still needed. To make it supportable, target: lower the target to about $25,500, the most the openings held bring with every buyer agreeing at the top price. The conclusion covers the openings held; markets nobody has counted are not ruled out, so Brain keeps searching for openings outside them.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is correct: the constraint holds even with all evidence in. The association directory counts 85 member clubs in total, each needing one workbook; at the evidenced $300 the whole market is 85 x $300 = $25,500 gross ($25,160 net of $4 each), below $40,000, which needs 134 sales (133 x 300 = 39,900). Every other link (reach, demand, price, 25% conversion, Brain fulfilment, $0 exposure, 3-day settlement) is established; MARKET_VOLUME is decisive and is a ceiling, not missing evidence.
findings: Recomputed: 134 sales needed vs 85 buyers buying once.
Measured expectation at 25% conversion of 85 = ~21 sales (~$6,375), consistent with the author's ~$6,300 note.
If the 10 recorded agreements are among the 85 clubs, the remaining ceiling is lower still; the conclusion is unchanged.
TARGET constraint suggestion (<= $25,500) is grounded in buyerVolume and price facts and matches Brain's NOT_VIABLE.
